common_language_save_failed: Could not save the language for your account. Please try again.
common_impact_changed: The impact just changed. Review it, then confirm.
common_language_unsaved_description: The page reloads to switch language, so any unsaved changes on this page will be lost.
common_maintenance_default_message: We are upgrading the platform. Please come back in a few minutes.
privacy_requests_subtitle: Under Decree 13/2023 you can get a copy of your data or ask us to delete your account. Requests are handled within 72 hours.
privacy_export_desc: Get a JSON file with your account details, profile and activity. You can download it for 7 days after the request is approved.
privacy_erasure_desc: Your account is anonymized and your CVs and profile are permanently deleted. CVs already submitted to employers stay in their hiring records.
privacy_erasure_confirm_body: Once the request is processed you are signed out on every device and the account cannot be restored. Export your data first if you want to keep it.
privacy_request_sent: Request sent. We will handle it within 72 hours.
privacy_request_failed: Could not send the request. Please try again.
privacy_cancel_failed: Could not cancel the request. Please try again.
privacy_download_failed: Could not download the data. Please try again.
cookie_policy_what_body: Cookies and browser storage are small pieces of data that keep ProCV running reliably, remember your choices and – when you allow it – measure how the product performs.
cookie_policy_table_title: Data we store on your device
cookie_policy_p_consent_mirror: Copy of your cookie choice used to render the interface
cookie_policy_p_refresh: Keeps you signed in to each portal
cookie_policy_p_logout: Signs you out of every open tab at once
cookie_policy_p_sound: Remembers that you muted notification sounds; stops one notification ringing in several tabs
cookie_policy_p_job_feedback: Remembers that you rated a job posting
cookie_policy_p_session: The location you picked for "Jobs near me"; employer sign-up steps
cookie_policy_p_saved_filter: Job filters you chose to save
cookie_policy_p_compare: Remembers up to three jobs you are comparing
cookie_policy_p_viewer: Avoids double-counting views of job postings and system announcements
cookie_policy_p_campaign: Records which campaign channel brought you to a job when you apply
cookie_policy_d_until_withdraw: Until you withdraw consent or clear data
cookie_policy_third_recaptcha: loads only on the sign-in, sign-up and password reset screens to block fake accounts and password guessing. Google may set its own cookies; this is an essential security measure.
cookie_policy_third_embeds: load only when you press play or open the map. YouTube videos use youtube-nocookie.com.
cookie_policy_third_errors: (when enabled) sets no cookies and never sends cookies, form data or URL parameters.
cookie_policy_third_marketing: is not used yet: ProCV has no advertising or retargeting partners.
cookie_policy_views_body: When you allow analytics cookies, ProCV may create a random ID that contains no email, name or profile content. It limits each posting to one view per 24 hours so the numbers are not inflated.
cookie_policy_change_body: Open Cookie settings in the footer at any time to turn categories on or off or withdraw consent. With Preferences off, theme, search history, saved filters and the comparison list last only for the current tab; with Analytics off, ProCV deletes the de-duplication ID and the campaign channel code. The matching browser data is deleted as soon as you save your choice.
